_about: Play Data safety answers. Build the importable CSV with: node Docs_UNI_SIM/store-kit/data-safety.mjs Universal_Apps/Universal_PDF/store-assets/data-safety.json Universal_Apps/Universal_PDF/store-assets/out/play/data-safety.csv. PREPARED 2026-11-21, NOT YET IMPORTED (James approves store uploads; import it with the first Play release built from Universal_PDF after this change, not before: the build on Play does not show the name). Updated for the phone app recognising the suite sign-in (James, 2026-11-21). It still has NO sign-in of its own and creates no accounts (src/main.tsx `noAccounts: accountsOff()` + `signInInTune: !isNativeShell()`, src/lib/accounts.ts), hence PSL_ACM_NONE. But when the phone already holds a UNI·SIM session made by another suite app (Android's shared suite provider), the app reads and follows it: Name and Email address (optional; App functionality + Personalisation) give the desk's title 'Bradley's PDFs' (src/native/personalTitle.ts, the SDK's useCallMe: Global Tuning's Call me, else the profile's name, else a name-shaped email); User IDs (optional; App functionality) is the account id that keys the reads and writes; Other actions (optional; App functionality) is Tune this app's choices (colour scheme, language, default views) saved to the account's tune:pdf row by the SDK's TuneSync. Optional = only for someone already signed in elsewhere. Unchanged: no 'session.opened' event (<UsageTracker /> is off in the phone app), no files uploaded (signing and 'Send for signature' happen on the device; the certified-signature route is website-only), no usage count (`openCount` is web-only; the old install-id user count was retired in @unisim/sdk 0.187.0). Google's: the Android Scan button uses Google's ML Kit document scanner (play-services-mlkit-document-scanner, DocumentScannerPlugin.java); per https://developers.google.com/ml-kit/android-data-disclosure (checked 2026-10-12) every ML Kit Android SDK sends Google device info (make, model, OS), app info (package, version), a per-installation id, performance metrics, API config, event types and error codes 'for diagnostics and usage analytics', HTTPS, not transferred to third parties. Declared as Device or other IDs + Diagnostics, optional (only when the user taps Scan), Analytics; collected, not shared (Google processes it as the SDK provider). Mirrors ios/App/App/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy and PRIVACY.md.
